g.text: Self-serve scope: synthetic and non-sensitive data only.
No high-risk MCP servers. Regional model approvals apply.
Intake is NOT required here — it is required at the gate.
The gate is where Governance by Design intake happens.
The verdict is per resource per environment and is re-taken
on every promotion — a STAGE verdict is not a PROD verdict.
One integration point: ACP to Archer.
Governance by Design reads ACP, not Archer.
Use case classification sets the bounds agents stay within.
